evidence.evidence_text: To harness the knowledge storage of LLMs, we propose a framework named KnowEE that explores multi-source multi-type knowledge from LLMs by leveraging diverse datasets and then exploits the obtained knowledge for response generation.
Recently, large language models (LLMs) have shown impressive performance on natural language processing tasks.
Existing models typically focus on identifying specific types of dialogue knowledge and utilize corresponding datasets for training.
Recently, large language models (LLMs) have shown impressive performance on natural language processing tasks.

Both automatic and manual evaluation results validate the effectiveness of our framework in exploring and exploiting multi-source multi-type knowledge to generate coherent, informative, and fluent responses.
